card.name: First digit after 1-800- in phone numbers
card.fires_on: The single digit right after '1-800-' in a toll-free phone number, mostly the poison control number in overdose sections. Also fires on the same spot in a manufacturer's reporting line.

modes.label: Poison control number
modes.description: The digit 2 starting the poison control line after 1-800- in overdose advice.
modes.example: CONTACT A POISON CONTROL CENTER IMMEDIATELY 1-800-<<2>>22-1222.

modes.label: Company contact number
modes.description: The first digit after 1-800- in a company's reporting phone number.

card.writes: It adds a push toward words about guidance and recommendations, which fits the advice-to-contact context.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a toll-free number, usually the poison control line, in advice on who to call.
